title: 连接LLM智能体与数据空间：基于模型上下文协议的架构中介方法
summary: 本文提出基于MCP的架构中介方法，通过Eunomia Agent实现LLM智能体与数据空间服务的受控交互，将数据空间能力转化为结构化工具，在保持治理约束的同时实现端到端集成。
summary_en: This paper presents an MCP-based architectural mediation approach, implemented via the Eunomia Agent, enabling controlled interaction between LLM agents and data space services by translating data space capabilities into structured, schema-driven tools while preserving governance constraints.
